description: THE PRIMARY conversion surface — converts between assets/networks end to end (e.g. DEPIX→LBTC, LBTC→BTC@lightning, DEPIX→USDT@ethereum) in ONE call; prefer it over the low-level provider tools (wallet_swap_*, wallet_to_stablecoin, wallet_shift_usdt). Executes exactly ONE route: single-hop directly, multi-hop legs sequentially behind a crash-safe persisted plan (wallet_recover resumes after any interruption). MOVES MONEY: every money-moving leg passes through the owner's guardrails BEFORE signing; routes transiting a custodial provider return custodial:true. If several candidate routes resolve the intent, the call fails with MULTIPLE_ROUTES_AVAILABLE and the candidates in error.data.routes — call wallet_quote and pass `route`. Outbound cross-network routes need `address` (or `invoice` for lightning). Waits for settlement by default; on timeout it returns status pending with a next_step — funds in flight are never lost. amount_sats is the FROM asset's BASE UNITS.

address.description: FINAL destination address for outbound cross-network routes (peg-out BTC address, EVM/Tron stablecoin address, SideShift settle address). Checked against the allowlist when it is ON (§4.3).

amount_sats.description: Amount in the asset's BASE UNITS (sats), as a decimal integer STRING. 1 DePix cent = 1,000,000 sats. Never pass a BRL value here.

from.description: Asset to convert FROM: DEPIX, USDT, LBTC (L-BTC), BTC or USDC.

from_network.description: ORIGIN network of `from`. Liquid assets default to liquid (this wallet's holdings); set it for external inflows (BTC: bitcoin | lightning; inbound USDT: its source network).

invoice.description: BOLT11 invoice — the destination of an LBTC → BTC@lightning conversion (its embedded amount governs; amount_sats is used only for quoting).

network.description: DESTINATION network of `to` (default liquid). e.g. lightning for a BOLT11 payout, ethereum/tron/… for an external stablecoin delivery.

refund_address.description: Optional Liquid refund address for SideShift send routes. Checked against the allowlist when it is ON.

route.description: A route id from wallet_quote. REQUIRED when more than one candidate route resolves the intent (the SDK never chooses for you — MULTIPLE_ROUTES_AVAILABLE lists the candidates).

timeout_seconds.description: Settlement wait bound in seconds (hard ceiling 900). On timeout the result is status pending with a next_step — funds in flight are never an error.

to.description: Asset to convert TO: DEPIX, USDT, LBTC (L-BTC), BTC or USDC.

wait.description: Wait for settlement (default true). Inflow routes return funding details immediately either way; with wait:false outbound routes return status pending right after the first broadcast.

name: wallet_convert

custodial.description: true when the executed route transits a custodial provider (G4, signalled).

funding.description: Funding instructions for INFLOW routes (only with status awaiting_funding).

address.description: Address the EXTERNAL party funds (BTC or provider deposit address).

expires_at.description: Epoch-ms funding deadline, when the provider sets one.

invoice.description: BOLT11 invoice for the payer to pay.

network.description: The network the external funds must be sent on.

next_step.description: What to do next when the result is not terminal — always actionable (G3).

post_sync_failed.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) AFTER this money-moving call failed. The money already moved (see the txid); the next balance read reflects it. This is never a failure of the operation itself.

received_sats.description: ACTUAL receipt in 8-decimal base units of `to` (string) — null until the provider reports delivery.

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

status.description: settled = delivered. pending/refund_pending = in flight (see next_step; wallet_recover resumes). awaiting_funding = an external party must fund first (see funding). refunded/failed = terminal, nothing delivered.

tracking_id.description: Provider tracking id (swap id / shift id / peg order id).

txids.description: Every txid the conversion produced so far (lockup/send first, payout/claim after).

title: Convert (primary surface)
